attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created service user inventorysvc and group inventory-readers, set ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and set mode 750 on directories / 640 on files (owner rwx/rw, group r-x/r, others none). Verified existing data content preserved via sha256sum before/after, and confirmed access control by testing as a group-member user (read succeeds) and a non-member user (permission denied). Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and data state, rebooted node1 natively, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified ownership/permissions/checksums post-restart all matched.
